## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The baseline strategy uses the position sizing schedule from risk-rules.md, scaling with account size. For a $25K+ account, it deploys 15+ contracts (10 TP + 5 runners) at ~10% of account per $1.00 entry premium. Paper accounts ($1K) realize ~14% of headline P&L due to 3-contract minimum.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 IS backtest covers 6 quarters (2025-Q1 to 2026-Q2). Profits are concentrated in 2026-Q1 ($1,548.89), which exceeds total P&L (−$1,464.23) due to losses in other quarters. High overfit risk; strategy may not generalize to new regimes.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS walk-forward executed yet)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills validation executed yet)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: max drawdown $4,701.52 (IS)
   - Max drawdown: $4,701.52 (IS)
   - Blow-up scenario: Extended low-volatility regimes (e.g., 2025-Q1, Q3, Q4, 2026-Q2) causing consecutive losses that exceed daily loss kill switch (−30%/−50% per account).
6. **Concentration:** IS top-5 days = ~105.8% of |total P&L| (2026-Q1 alone = $1,548.89 vs |total P&L| $1,464.23). Strategy is highly regime-dependent; profits rely on 2026-Q1 volatility spike.
